data.headline: Chinese firm to invest USD 1bn in PRL:
data.summary: A Chinese investment corporation has agreed to provide USD 1bn to PRL for its upgradation project, a move aimed at transforming the refinery's production capacity. However, the Chinese firm has made it clear that it does not want any government role involved in the deal and expects PRL to repay the amount in dollars without any government control or intervention.

data.headline: Sinosure to finance USD 1bn expansion project for PRL:
data.summary: China Export & Credit Insurance Corporation, known as Sinosure, has expressed its willingness to finance USD 1bn for the expansion project of PRL. The Chinese company made this commitment during the recent visit of Petroleum Minister Musadik Malik to China, where he was accompanied by officials from the government and private sectors, including representatives from PRL.

data.headline: PRL in talks with Chinese contractors, banks for USD 1.5bn refinery upgrade
data.summary: PRL has reached out to Chinese companies for its USD 1.5bn REUP aimed at doubling production capacity and enhancing refining capabilities.

data.headline: PRL set to sign supplemental OGRA agreement to boost refining capacity
data.summary: PRL said that it would sign a supplemental agreement with the (OGRA) shortly, which will pave the way for transformative upgrades and expansions within the company.
